sn22.68:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || pahitatto vihareyyanti || || Yo kho bhikkhu anattā || tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || || Aññātaṃ Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || ||
sn22.68:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante anattā || tatra me chando pahātabbo || Vedanā || || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam anattā || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || ||
sn22.68:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evam vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu anattā || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇam anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhave mayā {saṅkhittena} bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti || || ||Pa || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || ||
